_demand_record.unit: gross passenger one-way crossing journeys across both directions/year

_fare_record.method: Premium-substitute benchmarking per Jaideep override (Jul 2026): Navier is priced against the premium point-to-point car tier (Uber Black), not the commuter public-ferry fare. $30/pax is the Uber Black comparable for the ~10 km Cancun metro trip mirroring the Puerto Juarez/Punta Sam -> Isla Mujeres crossing (no road exists across the channel; comparable derived from the equivalent land trip). Applied uniformly across the three supported Quintana Roo Caribbean crossings; conservative for the longer Playa del Carmen<->Cozumel leg. Jaideep-approved 2026-07-17. Not claimed as operator realized yield.

_prior_commuter_fare_record.method: MXN 290 public adult online fare / 19.2375083333333 MXN/USD 2025 official-period-average FX. Conservative comparable benchmark; not claimed as operator realized yield or resident-weighted fare mix.
